---
name: Improvement request
about: Suggest an improvement to an existing feature or functionality
title: '[Improvement]'
labels: team:backend, type:refactor
assignees: ''
type: Improvement
---

### Description

Provide a clear and concise description of the existing feature or functionality and what should be improved.

### Current Behavior

Describe how the feature currently works, including any limitations or issues.

### Proposed Improvement

Describe the desired changes and how the improved behavior should work.

### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The proposed improvement is implemented as described.
- [ ] Existing functionality continues to work as expected.
- [ ] Relevant edge cases and error states are handled.
- [ ] The updated behavior meets the intended use case.

### Additional Context

Include relevant screenshots, references, related issues, dependencies, or other information needed to implement the improvement.
